content: परिग्रह् €9 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To clasp round, embrace. .²2 To encircle; surround, fence or hedge round; न्यविशन्त ततः सर्वे परिगृह्य सरस्वतीम् <ls>Mb. 5. 178. 23</ls>. .²3 To lay hold of, seize. .²4 To take, assume. .²5 To accept. .²6 To favour, patronize; देवेन च परिगृहीतः <ls>M. 1</ls>, <ls n="M.">1. 13</ls>. .²7 To support, assist, guide; राक्षसमतिपरिगृहीतः <ls>Mu. 1</ls>. .²8 To put on (a dress). .²9 To take possession of, master, overpower. .²10 To conceive, comprehend. .²11 To undertake. .²12 To receive hospitably; परिग्रहेण ब्राह्मेण परिगृह्य महाद्युतिः <ls>Mb. 1. 195. 1</ls>. .²13 To take (a wife), marry; प्रथमपरिगृहीतं स्यान्न वेत्यव्यवस्यन् <ls>Ś. 5. 19</ls>. .²14 To conform to, follow. .²15 To surpass, excel.
